summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a new US$25 million secured revolving term credit facility with ING Capital LLC as administrative agent. The facility includes an accordion feature allowing increases up to an additional US$75 million, for a maximum of US$100 million, with a three-year term maturing August 5, 2029. Proceeds are for general corporate and working capital purposes, including permitted acquisitions. The filing is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: facility conditions and potential draws for growth initiatives.
